desc: Re-derive the finite-field power-sum argument and classify all length-\(p\) walks whose zero-entry multiplicities are divisible by \(p-1\).
Correctly handle surviving walks with a zero loop repeated \(p-1\) times and one fixed edge for \(p>3\), including their contribution and orientation.
Derive the full exceptional \(p=3\) correction, including repeated non-loop zero edges and loop cases without double-counting.
Validate the resulting formulas by exhaustive small-\(N\), small-prime enumeration and public samples.
Design and implement the resulting formula using constraint-suitable matrix operations, with correct signs and formatting.
